lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Four hundred and six. Not four hundred and one. I was five short for eleven days because five of them never came out of the sand at all.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Four hundred and six is the payroll. That is the Basin crew list, and I have read the other copy.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Then they have names. That is all I wanted and I am not going to be able to explain why.
